text: Our elders marked it as a day to turn attention inward — away from appetite and towards remembrance.
The point was never the empty stomach; it was the quiet it made room for.
You can chant 'Om Namo Narayanaya' while doing your ordinary work, or read a few names from Vishnu Sahasranamam.
In the evening, light a deepam and take one still minute in front of it.
